'''Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth''' (born around 1960) is a German [[physicist]] and academic administrator serving as the [[University president|president]] of the [[Technische Hochschule Aschaffenburg|TH Aschaffenburg]] since 2019.<ref name="DNB">{{cite web |title=Katalog der Deutschen Nationalbibliothek (Catalog of the German National Library) |url=https://portal.dnb.de/opac/moveDown?currentResultId=Eva-Maria+and+Beck-Meuth%26any&categoryId=persons |website=portal.dnb.de |access-date=12 May 2025}}</ref><ref name="Pres_announce">{{cite web |title=Neue Präsidentin für die Hochschule (New president for the Hochschule) |url=https://www.th-ab.de/fileadmin/th-ab-redaktion/dokumente/Oeffentlichkeitsarbeit/Publikationen/Campus_aktuell/oeffentlichkeitsarbeit-publikation-campus-aktuell-2019-1.pdf |website=Campus Aktuell, 2019 Volume 1 |access-date=12 May 2025}}</ref> TH Aschaffenburg is a [[Technische Hochschule]] (university of applied science) in [[Aschaffenburg]], [[Germany]], and is one of Germany's youngest TH universities (founded 1995).<ref>{{cite web |title=University Profile |url=https://www.th-ab.de/en/english/welcome/ |website=www.th-ab.de |access-date=12 May 2025 |language=en}}</ref>

== Professional life ==
Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth studied [[Physics]] at the [[Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München]] during 1979–1984, and graduated with a ''Diplom'' (German qualification similar to a [[Master's degree|Master's]]). After graduating, she moved to [[Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory]] at the [[University of California, Berkeley]]. After two years, she returned to Germany, and obtained her doctorate in [[Experimental Physics]] from the [[Rheinische Friedrich-Wilhelms-Universität Bonn]] in 1988.<ref name="cv">{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth |url=https://www.th-ab.de/hochschule/organisation/person/prof-dr-eva-maria-beck-meuth |website=www.th-ab.de |access-date=12 May 2025 |language=de}}</ref> Her thesis was entitled "[[Atomic nucleus|Nuclear]] shapes at very high [[nuclear spin|spins]], an experimental study in [[Rare-earth element|rare-earth]] nuclei".<ref name="DNB" />

After completing her PhD and before returning to academia, she worked for several years at the [[Alexander von Humboldt Foundation]] in [[Bonn]], [[Deutsche Telekom]] in [[Darmstadt]],<ref name="cv" /><ref>{{cite news |last1=Dölling |first1=Hanna |last2=Bay |first2=Jana |title=Einstieg in die Sonderreihe – Was macht den Karriereweg HAW-Professur besonders? (Introduction to the special series – What makes the HAW professorship career path special?) |url=https://wissenschaftspodcasts.de/podcasts/lehrfunk-der-podcast-fuer-hochschullehre/einstieg-in-die-sonderreihe-was-macht-den-karriereweg-haw-professur-besonders-9781132/ |access-date=20 June 2025 |work=wissenschaftspodcasts.de |language=de}}</ref> and [[Thales Alenia Space|Alcatel Space Operations]] in Darmstadt.<ref name="Pres_announce"/>

She was appointed [[professor]] in the Faculty of [[Engineering]] at TH Aschaffenburg in 2002.<ref name="Pres_announce"/> Her transition from research and teaching to university administration began with her appointment as [[Dean (education)|Dean]] of the Faculty of [[Engineering]] and [[Computer Science]] in 2011. In 2013, she became the University's Vice President for Studies, Teaching and International Affairs, and in 2019, she was elected president.<ref name="cv"/> In addition to teaching at Aschaffenburg, she has also taught summer courses, including at [[Universität Bremen]].<ref name="UB">{{cite web |title=Ingenieurinnen-Sommeruni, Universität Bremen (Summer University for Women Engineers, University of Bremen) |url=https://www.ingenieurinnen-sommeruni.de/Archiv/Sommerstudium/Sommer2011/Dozentinnen.php |website=www.ingenieurinnen-sommeruni.de |access-date=12 May 2025}}</ref>

Beck-Meuth's appointment to president (on March 15, 2019) coincided with the renaming of the university from ''Hochschule für angewandte Wissenschaften'' (University of applied science) to TH Aschaffenburg. Her predecessor in the position was [[Wilfried Diwischek]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Beck-Meuth erhält Ernennungsurkunde zur Hochschulpräsidentin |url=https://www.stmwk.bayern.de/wissenschaftler/meldung/6175/prof-dr-beck-meuth-erhaelt-ernennungsurkunde-zur-hochschulpraesidentin.html |website=www.stmwk.bayern.de |access-date=12 May 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth wird Präsidentin der Hochschule Aschaffenburg (Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth becomes President of Aschaffenburg University of Applied Sciences) |url=https://www.main-echo.de/region/stadt-kreis-aschaffenburg/eva-maria-beck-meuth-wird-praesidentin-der-hochschule-aschaffenburg-art-6547655 |website=www.main-echo.de |publisher=Main-Echo |access-date=12 May 2025 |language=de |date=15 November 2018}}</ref> In 2024, she was reelected to a further six year term.<ref>{{cite web |title=Präsidentin der TH Aschaffenburg wiedergewählt ( Präsidentin der TH Aschaffenburg wiedergewählt ) |url=https://www.th-ab.de/hochschule/aktuelles/presse/artikel/praesidentin-der-th-aschaffenburg-wiedergewaehlt |website=www.th-ab.de |access-date=12 May 2025 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Prof. Dr. Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth für weitere sechs Jahre Präsidentin an der TH Aschaffenburg (Prof. Dr. Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth President of the TH Franken |access-date=12 May 2025 |language=de}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Aschaffenburger TH-Präsidentin Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth über die Zukunft der Technischen Hochschule |url=https://www.main-echo.de/region/stadt-kreis-aschaffenburg/aschaffenburger-th-praesidentin-eva-maria-beck-meuth-ueber-die-zukunft-der-technischen-hochschule-art-8429191 |access-date=17 June 2025 June 2025 |language=de-de}}</ref>

During Beck-Meuth's tenure, the number of students has increased to about 3,500, and a new [[midwifery]] program has been launched.<ref>{{cite web |title=TH Aschaffenburg: Mehr Studenten und neuer Studiengang (TH Aschaffenburg: more students and new study program) |url=https://www.primavera24.de/aktuelles/news/hochschule-aschaffenburg-mehr-studenten-und-neuer-studiengang |website=Radio Primavera |access-date=20 June 2025 |language=de-DE}}</ref> In the fall of 2025, a new degree program in social work will begin.<ref>{{cite web |title=Leben und arbeiten am Bayerischen Untermain (Living and working on the Bavarian Lower Main) |url=https://www.ihk.de/aschaffenburg/wabu-online/neuer-inhalt03-04-stimmen-aus-der-region-6508426 |website=IHK Aschaffenburg |access-date=20 June 2025}}</ref>

== Personal life ==

Beck-Meuth is an alumna of the [[Studienstiftung]].<ref name="cv" /><ref name="Laudatio" /> She has three adult children.<ref name="Pres_announce" />

== Awards and honors ==

* 2023 [[Bayerische Verfassungsmedaille|Bavarian Constitution Medal]] for her contributions to [[STEM]] and recruitment of women to STEM fields<ref name="Laudatio">{{cite web |title=Verleihung des Bayerischen Verfassungsordens 2023 (Award of the Bavarian Constitutional Order 2023) |url=https://www.bayern.landtag.de/fileadmin/Bilder_Videos_Internet/K_2_Online-Kommunikation/Laudationes_Verfassungsorden_2023.pdf |publisher=Bayerischer Landtag (Bavarian State Parliament) |access-date=12 May 2025}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Bayerischer Verfassungsorden für TH-Präsidentin Eva-Maria Beck-Meuth und Unternehmerin Vanessa Weber |url=https://www.main-echo.de/region/stadt-kreis-aschaffenburg/bayerischer-verfassungsorden-fuer-th-praesidentin-eva-maria-beck-meuth-und-unternehmerin-vanessa-weber-art-8157588 |access-date=20 June 2025 |work=www.main-echo.de |date=8 February 2024 |language=de}}</ref>
